visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: One Pass Instead of Two
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Two separate loops scan the array, one for the largest and one for the smallest. Put the logic in one function that finds both in a single pass. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A C function can return only one value, so two results are passed back through pointers. The array is now read once, and the loop starts at index 1 because index 0 already seeded both values.
